show.description: After a multibillionaire living a secret life as a hotel cleaner saves a young tech CEO from a ruthless mafia don, the two enter a contract marriage that forces him to navigate his hidden empire, a treacherous business summit, and his own son’s ignorance to dismantle a corrupt criminal cartel.
